post.description:
Sign in with email and password.

The access token is returned in the body; the refresh token is set as an
httpOnly cookie.
Swap the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new cookie.
End the login session; always succeeds.
Get an access token bound to another merchant you belong to.

get.description:
Who is signed in, for which merchant, and what they may do.

The portal uses this to draw only what the person can use. The server
still checks every request itself.

post.description:
The old address is retired for good, so no one else can take it and
old links never open another business.

Takes the outlet off the public page and off every team member's
outlet list. There is no delete: orders will point at outlets.

Brings it back private. Team members who lost it must be given it
again.

Invite someone. The response carries the token once; the portal builds
the link from it (an email is sent too once TASK-110 lands).

Public. Attempts are limited per address and per token, the same way
as login, because an existing user proves themselves with a password.

get.description:
Public. Shows the accept page what it needs. Limited like accepting,
and an invalid token counts as a failure, so tokens cannot be guessed.

LegalUpdate.title: LegalUpdate
LegalUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change; null clears a field.

MemberUpdate.title: MemberUpdate
MemberUpdate.description:
Send only what changes. ``outletIds`` limits the member to those
outlets (and so turns ``allOutlets`` off); ``allOutlets: true`` lifts any
limit. Sending both ``outletIds`` and ``allOutlets: true`` is refused.

OutletUpdate.title: OutletUpdate
OutletUpdate.description:
Send only what changes. Optional text and the map pin may be null to
clear. A new outlet starts private; ``isPublic`` is how it goes live.

SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate
SettingsUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change. Text fields may be null to clear.
